summary.text: Jim Toomey is the Democratic candidate for the Alabama House of Representatives, District 47, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Mike Shaw.

paragraphs.text: Toomey was the Democratic nominee for District 47 in 2018, when he lost the general election to David Wheeler, 54.3 percent to 45.7 percent.
He ran in the Democratic primary for the seat again in 2022 and lost to Christian Coleman by a narrow margin.
For 2026, Toomey advanced to the general election without appearing on a primary ballot, because the Democratic primary scheduled for May 19, 2026, was canceled.
